title: Your First Weekend at Lawrence University, Shared as Cards
description: A flexible, under-21-safe sequence for learning Lawrence’s campus, exploring nearby Appleton, and finding places to eat, study, make art, exercise, and gather.

cards.title: Start at Warch
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Get oriented by the Fox River
cards.notes: Begin at the third-level information desk, ask about weekend events, and note where dining, student offices, and the cinema are located.
cards.short_summary: Use Lawrence’s central gathering place to establish your bearings before the weekend unfolds.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence identifies Warch as a public gathering place containing dining facilities, student organization offices, event spaces, a cinema, and a third-level information desk.
cards.access_notes: The information desk lists academic-year hours of 8 a.m.–7 p.m. daily; summer hours vary. Building access may follow university security policies.

cards.title: Share a First Meal
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Dine on Warch’s lower level
cards.notes: Check the current menu, choose a station that fits your dietary needs, and use the meal as an easy opening for conversation with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: A campus meal creates a natural transition from arrival logistics to meeting people.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence describes Andrew Commons as an all-you-can-eat dining facility with specialty stations, Fox River views, and weekend meal periods.
cards.access_notes: The published academic schedule lists Saturday–Sunday service from 9 a.m.–2 p.m. and 4:30–7:30 p.m.; hours change during reading periods and breaks.

cards.title: Check the Cinema Schedule
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Look for a campus screening
cards.notes: Review the campus events listing, then head to Warch’s second level only if a screening or other student-accessible program is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled campus film offers a low-pressure first-night activity without leaving Lawrence.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence states that Warch Cinema is on the campus center’s second level and hosts free film screenings and other large events.
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on the event schedule and any audience restrictions; confirm the specific screening in Lawrence’s calendar before going.

cards.title: Learn the Campus Spine
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Walk through Main Hall Green
cards.notes: Download Lawrence’s map, locate Main Hall Green, and trace a short route past the library, art center, chapel, and campus center.
cards.short_summary: A map-led morning loop connects the landmarks you will use throughout your first term.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence’s official campus map identifies Main Hall, nearby academic and arts buildings, Warch Campus Center, and campus walkways.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus walkways are the focus; consult the current map for accessible routes and do not assume surrounding buildings are unlocked.

cards.title: Find Your Library Base
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Explore study and making resources
cards.notes: Walk the public areas, identify a study spot, and ask how equipment reservations, research appointments, and Makerspace access work.
cards.short_summary: An early library visit turns an unfamiliar academic building into a practical home base.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official page highlights study spaces, research appointments, equipment reservations, Lawrence scholarship, and its Makerspace.
cards.source_title: Seeley G. Mudd Library | Lawrence University
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by academic session and break; verify the library calendar. Some resources, equipment, or rooms may require Lawrence credentials.

cards.title: Step Into Wriston
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · See original art on campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition page before walking over, and arrange access in advance if the university’s appointment policy applies to you.
cards.short_summary: Three exhibition spaces provide a focused introduction to Lawrence’s visual-arts community.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence says Wriston contains three exhibition spaces showing contemporary art, collection selections, and the annual Senior Art Show.
cards.access_notes: Closed for summer break through the start of Fall 2026 exhibitions. Non-current students, faculty, and staff must arrange an appointment under the posted policy.

cards.title: Cross Into Appleton History
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Visit 330 East College Avenue
cards.notes: Walk west along College Avenue, allow time for three exhibit levels, and bring a student ID or payment method for the applicable admission rate.
cards.short_summary: The nearby museum adds Fox Valley history to a first exploration beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official visitor page lists its address, daily 10 a.m.–4 p.m. hours, three accessible exhibit levels, and current admission prices.
cards.source_title: Visit | History Museum at the Castle
cards.access_notes: Open daily 10 a.m.–4 p.m. except listed holidays. The elevator entrance is off the northwest side of the museum parking lot.

cards.title: Claim a Downtown Reading Stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Visit 200 North Appleton Street
cards.notes: Browse the new-to-you building, identify quiet and collaborative areas, and ask staff about cards, events, and services available to students.
cards.short_summary: The municipal library expands your study map into downtown Appleton.
cards.evidence_claim: Appleton Public Library’s official page gives its 200 North Appleton Street location and public hours, including Saturday service from 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Saturday hours are 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday hours are noon–5 p.m.; borrowing privileges and reservable services may require registration.

cards.title: Hear the Chapel in Use
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Choose a listed performance
cards.notes: Consult the university calendar for a public concert or recital, confirm whether tickets are required, and arrive early enough to find the entrance.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled performance introduces the Conservatory through one of Lawrence’s principal venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence identifies Memorial Chapel as a 1,184-seat venue used for ensemble concerts, public events, convocations, and the Performing Arts Series.
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent. Exterior doors may be locked; the box-office number is posted for entry assistance. Photography and recording are prohibited during performances.

cards.title: Reset Before Monday
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Try a low-key recreation session
cards.notes: Bring your Lawrence ID, check facility availability, and choose a manageable activity such as the track, pool, gym, or checked-out recreation equipment.
cards.short_summary: A short Sunday workout closes the weekend with a repeatable campus routine.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence lists a pool, gymnasium, jogging track, weight and cardio rooms, and other facilities at the Buchanan Kiewit Wellness Center.
cards.access_notes: A valid Lawrence ID is required. Academic Sunday building hours are listed as 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; pool and space availability follow separate schedules.
